definitions.explanation: A distance that falls between short and long range. Used in athletics (middle-distance running), military contexts (missile range), transportation, and general descriptions of distance.

examples.japanese: {中距離|ちゅうきょり}{走|そう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧。
{中距離|ちゅうきょり}⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配備|はいび}→配備：25292_haibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The deployment of medium-range missiles has become an issue.

examples.japanese: {中距離|ちゅうきょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧なら⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: For a medium-distance commute, driving can sometimes be more convenient than taking the train.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) and ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (distance). Commonly used as a prefix-like modifier in compound nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}{走|そう}: middle-distance running (typically 800m to 1500m)
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧: medium-range missile
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧: medium-distance commute
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧: medium-distance bus

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{短距離|たんきょり}→短距離：09270_tankyori⟧: short distance — the shorter end of the scale
- ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧: long distance — the longer end of the scale
- ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: distance — the base word

USAGE:
In track and field, {中距離|ちゅうきょり} typically refers to 800m and 1500m events. In military contexts, definitions of medium range vary by era and weapon system.
